- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").

- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

## 经验教训

- [2026-05-14] **MCKP 在低压缩率(2x)下反而不如 uniform**：budget=0.5 时 uniform 8-bit PPL=10.10 vs MCKP PPL=10.66。原因：PPL profiler 在 4-bit 和 8-bit 之间分辨率坍缩（delta≈0），solver 误判降级免费。uniform 8-bit 已近无损（+0.29 vs FP16）。论文 Claim 2 限定为 "moderate-to-aggressive compression (≥4x)"。
- [2026-05-14] **Greedy total_distortion=0 解释**：大多数中间/后层 head 在单独量化到 2-bit 时 profiled delta ≈ 0，但联合 68 heads 量化到 2-bit 导致 compounding error (PPL 32.45)。Additive profiling model 的根本盲点。cardinality constraint 作为 compounding non-additivity 的正则化。
- [2026-05-14] **8x 压缩下两者都不实用**：MCKP PPL=906.78 vs uniform PPL=14758.92。虽然 MCKP 好 16x，但绝对 PPL 太高。论文中 8x 作为 stress test — "even at extreme compression, L0 protection prevents total collapse"。
- [2026-05-14] **max_2bit 缩放问题**：Llama/Mistral 256 heads 用 max_2bit=8 仅占 3.1% (vs Qwen 112 heads 的 7.1%)。当前先用 8 跑 baseline，后续规划 max_2bit 缩放 ablation（按比例 ~18 for 256 heads）。
- [2026-05-14] **HF_HOME 必须显式设置**：服务器上 HF datasets 默认下载会超时。所有 pipeline 脚本必须在 import 前设 `os.environ["HF_HOME"] = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"` 和 `HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1`。WikiText-2 缓存在 `/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/datasets/wikitext/wikitext-2-raw-v1/`。
- [2026-05-14] **Lowres profiling 对多 head 模型不足**：Llama lowres (16×512) MCKP PPL=8.70 劣于 Uniform=8.47。256 heads + 低分辨率 calibration → delta 高度同质化 → solver 盲目分配。与 Qwen exp_e 完全一致（lowres 恶化 2.52, hires 降到 0.75）。**规则：head 数 >200 的模型必须用 hires profiling (≥64×2048)**。

- [2026-05-14] **Llama L0 sensitivity 远低于 Qwen**：确认。Llama hires 最终 MCKP=8.4498 仅比 uniform=8.4690 好 0.019，说明 Llama heads 间异质性低，L0 不是瓶颈。Claim 1 (heterogeneity) 是 architecture-dependent 特性，非 universal。
- [2026-05-14] **Mistral 确认 GQA 4:1 模式——即使 hires 也不够**：Mistral hires MCKP=7.3231 仍劣于 uniform=7.1314。三模型验证完毕：GQA 4:1 (256 heads) 在 4x 压缩下 MCKP 无优势。但 Llama aggressive (5.3x) MCKP=57.6 vs Uniform=2643.8，说明低 GQA 模型在更高压缩率下仍然受益巨大。**规则：论文中 Llama/Mistral 定位为 sensitivity analysis，不作为 universal validation。**
- [2026-05-14] **5.3x 是低 GQA 模型的 MCKP sweet spot**：budget=0.1875 (5.3x) 时 selective allocation (128@4bit + 128@2bit) vs all-2bit 产生 45x PPL 差异。8x 时 248/256 heads 被迫 2-bit，优化空间受限 (仅 11% 优势)。原因：5.3x 是 uniform baseline "刚开始严重退化"的拐点，MCKP 的 selective protection 价值最大化。

- [2026-05-14] **k ablation 三模型 pattern 完美分化**：(1) Qwen U 形曲线 k=8 最优 (2) Llama 平坦——natural 2-bit count=2，任何 k≥2 给出相同 allocation (3) Mistral 单调递增——k 越小越好但始终劣于 uniform。这个三分格局直接支撑 Claim 3 (heterogeneity-dependent diagnostic)。论文可展示 k vs PPL 三线图作为核心 figure。
- [2026-05-14] **Downstream accuracy 验证 PPL 趋势**：MCKP hires avg 0.6857 vs uniform 0.6597 (+2.60pp)，recovery rate 72.8%。ARC-C 上 MCKP 甚至超 baseline (0.5137 vs 0.4957)。PPL 改善确实转化为 downstream 增益，非 PPL-only 的 artifact。
- [2026-05-14] **K/V 分离不如 joint 优化**：K/V separated MCKP (11.22) 比 joint K=V MCKP (10.91) 差 +0.303 PPL。根因：V 量化 distortion 几乎为零（per-token quant 天然鲁棒），112 个 V head 全部被分配 4-bit，分离后增加的自由度只让 solver 更激进地压缩 K（16 个 K@2-bit vs joint 的 8 个）。与 KIVI (ICML 2024) 发现一致。论文定位：ablation 确认 joint K=V 分配的充分性。
- [2026-05-14] **Per-model optimal k 是公平 heuristic 比较的前提 (D041/D042)**：统一 k=16 对 Llama (natural 2-bit=2) 和 Mistral (optimal k=4) 严重不公平——强制 14-12 个额外 2-bit heads 引入人为 compounding error。校正后 heuristic gap 缩小 3-12x，但 MCKP 在所有正向模型上仍保持优势。附带发现：k 越小 → constraint 越紧 → solution space 越窄 → 任何 solver/heuristic 越趋同，进一步验证 "constraint is THE contribution"。Budget 匹配也是隐患：L0@8-bit + k@2-bit 的 exact budget 取决于 head 数量，Mistral k=4 heuristic budget=0.2559 > MCKP budget=0.248（heuristic 多 3% 内存却仍不如 MCKP，comparison 是 conservative）。
- [2026-05-14] **Cross-dataset calibration robustness 跨模型验证**：三模型 C4 vs WT2 校准 allocation agreement 均 >96%（Qwen 96.4%, Llama 97.7%, Mistral 96.5%）。低异质性模型 agreement 更高——heads 越均匀，不同校准源的 allocation 越趋同。实践意义：practitioners 无需 domain-specific 校准数据，通用语料（如 C4 随机子集）即可获得稳定的 bit 分配。论文 §4.5 的核心证据。
